answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Each submission hangs on the terrace of a task receipt, and the hollow is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Reaching the vertex of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on time-locked work history, split across independent auditors, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
